# locks/python-build.txt
# Pins Python packages used during source builds (PyTorch stack, vLLM build
# deps, FlashInfer build deps). Installed via uv with --require-hashes.
#
# Generated by: scripts/bump.sh
# Seed inputs:
#   - torch, torchvision, torchaudio, triton (from versions.env)
#   - vLLM requirements/build.txt + requirements/build/cuda.txt at VLLM_COMMIT
#   - FlashInfer pyproject.toml [build-system].requires at FLASHINFER_COMMIT
# Index URLs: PYPI_INDEX_URL + PYTORCH_INDEX_URL (cu130)
#
# DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY. Run scripts/bump.sh on the DGX Spark to regenerate.
# This file must be generated on Linux aarch64 to produce correct wheel hashes.
